antipattern.code:
def test_pcp_accuracy(model):
    prompts = ["Hello, world!"] * 4
    sampling_params = SamplingParams(
        temperature=0.0,
        max_tokens=128,
    )

    common_kwargs = {
        "max_model_len": 1024,
        "enforce_eager": True,
    }

    with VllmRunner(model, **common_kwargs, **cp_kwargs) as runner:
        outputs = runner.model.generate(prompts, sampling_params)
        output_list = [(o.outputs[0].index, o.outputs[0].text) for o in outputs]

    with VllmRunner(model, **common_kwargs, **tp_kwargs) as runner:
        outputs = runner.model.generate(prompts, sampling_params)
        output_list = [(o.outputs[0].index, o.outputs[0].text) for o in outputs]
